core_invariants: No named martial techniques or spell lists. Combat capability comes from attributes, universal disciplines, Qi, equipment, experience, doctrine and current physical state.
Qi and Qi Control use one universal cultivation system for every faction and person.
Actual capability stats are uncapped. Aptitudes are capped at 200 because aptitude is a bounded deterministic learning coefficient. Appearance is normalized 0-100.
Martial factions have exact conserved populations. Ordinary civilians are aggregate. Government forces are aggregate exact headcounts with registered troop tiers.

Riding horses are conserved aggregate faction assets. Exact mounted combat may allocate one ordinary unarmored horse per rider from that pool; rider control derives from existing attributes and current anatomy, not a Riding proficiency. Surviving horses return to the pool and combat-disabled/dead horses debit it exactly once.
No free people, money, equipment, food, herbs, medicine, buildings, enterprise levels, ranks, offices, reputation or stat gains may be created by narration.
All recurring world events come from a finite calendar registry; causal events must arise from persisted conditions and actor decisions.
